children.text: A pair of school uniforms to girls in Classes VI to VII.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - A pair of school uniforms to girls in Classes VI to VII.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The "Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna" is a government initiative launched to encourage the enrollment and retention of girl students in schools by providing them with school uniforms.

children.text: Introduced in 2006-07, the "Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna" aims to promote education among girl children by addressing barriers to school attendance, such as the lack of proper clothing. Under the scheme, girl students enrolled in Classes VI to VII in government schools receive a pair of school uniforms. This initiative seeks to improve enrollment, retention, and educational outcomes for girls.
